dedupe_keys.name: windsor molicel lithium cell impedance tests by operating condition

description: The public Mendeley release contains electrochemical-impedance measurements from Molicel INR-21700-P42A cylindrical lithium cells tested at the University of Windsor. The article describes four cells measured at states of charge of 20, 40, 60 and 80 percent, with several AC current amplitudes and rest periods. Repository metadata distinguish a pilot amplitude sweep on one cell from the main variability tests and list one EISdata.zip archive under CC BY 4.0. These laboratory spectra can calibrate a cell state-of-health or equivalent-circuit component in battery simulations, but they are not a field fleet record or a direct measure of pack-level lifetime. Four test cells, chosen currents and controlled laboratory temperature are limitations when extending estimates to vehicle or grid storage use. A reviewer-assessed use is checking impedance changes under operating-state assumptions. model-system-advisor-model-sam is a related storage-system model, but no cell-to-system parameter conversion was verified. No archive or measurement series was downloaded. Coverage is four cells and a pilot test in one Windsor laboratory.
